region.text: the sixty-five strongholds of Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen and Rinan (Hepu, which 'rose in response', lies east of the shape)

ledger.note: 40: the Trưng sisters rise at Mê Linh and take sixty-five strongholds. 'In the 16th year of the Jianwu era (40 AD)' Trưng Trắc 'and her sister rebelled and attacked the commandery'; 'Barbarians in Jiuzhen, Rinan, and Hepu supported her. She took sixty-five strongholds and established herself as queen' (Hou Hanshu); the Annals: 'In spring, second month' the sisters captured the commandery capital and Su Ding fled; 'Nam Hải, Cửu Chân, Nhật Nam, and Hợp Phố rose in response'; 'Her capital was Mê Linh'. The month is the lunar second month. A rebel state (rule 5), hatched in its own colour; the Han dossier should carry the matching loss and contest.

region.text: Jiaozhi (Giao Chỉ), the Red River delta with Mê Linh and the commandery seat

ledger.note: 42: Ma Yuan's army arrives; the Battle of Lãng Bạc. Emperor Guangwu 'commissioned Ma Yuan in 42 AD with 20,000 troops' (Hou Hanshu: 'in the 18th year (42 CE) with over 10,000 troops'); the Annals place the Battle of Lãng Bạc 'in spring, first month, of 42 AD' (the Hou Hanshu excerpt's '40 CE' for the same battle conflicts with its own year count). In 41 the court had ordered 'Trường Sa, Hợp Phố, and Giao Châu to prepare wagons, boats, roads, and supplies'. Blend over the delta until the spring of 43.

region.text: Jiaozhi (Giao Chỉ), the Red River delta with Mê Linh and the commandery seat

ledger.note: 43: the sisters defeated and killed; Jiaozhi returns to the Han. 'Summer next year (43 CE), in the fourth month' Ma Yuan 'beheaded Zheng Ce and Zheng Er' (another passage: 'the first month of next year (43 CE)'); the Annals: defeated in the spring of 43; the lead: 'either executed or committed suicide', while 'The Chinese account states they did not commit suicide'. No month given because the passages disagree (first or fourth month).

region.text: Jiaozhi (Giao Chỉ), the Red River delta with Mê Linh and the commandery seat

ledger.note: 43: the fighting in the delta ends with the sisters' death.

ledger.note: 43: Ma Yuan pacifies Jiuzhen. 'In the 10th month of the 19th year (43 CE), Ma Yuan entered Jiuzhen and the area was pacified'; he returned to the capital in 'Autumn of the 20th year (44 CE)'.

region.text: the sixty-five strongholds of Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen and Rinan (Hepu, which 'rose in response', lies east of the shape)

ledger.note: 43: the rebellion is over; Han magistrates installed. After the campaign the regions 'beyond the Ridge' were 'entirely pacified' and magistrates were installed; infobox 'Disestablished: Second Era of Northern Domination'. Cliopatria's row 43–50 misdates the whole episode.

sources.title: Trưng sisters
sources.note: The Hou Hanshu and Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư passages: 40 (second month), 41, 42 (Lãng Bạc, Ma Yuan's dispatch), 43 (the sisters' death; Jiuzhen in the tenth month), 44; capital Mê Linh. No infobox area.

notes:
Cliopatria row 'Trưng sisters' 43–50 (1 shape) kept as one dossier of type rebel (a rebellion against the Han that held land for three years, rule 5), dated 40–43 from the page; the row's years are wrong by three to seven years, the shape (Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, Rinan) is right apart from Hepu. The data README lists this Name among 'a person, house or party rather than a state'; the dossier names the realm, not the sisters.

Months are the Chinese lunar months as the page gives them ('spring, second month' of 40; 'first month' of 42; Jiuzhen 'in the 10th month' of 43); the sisters' death is the first or the fourth month of 43 depending on the passage, so that event has no month. The Battle of Lãng Bạc is misdated '40 CE' in one Hou Hanshu excerpt.

Requests to other dossiers: han-dynasty (ea-02) should carry the loss of Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen and Rinan in 40 (or a contest 40–43 as the government side, per the brief's rule for rebel states) and their recovery in 43. Only one page was opened (budget 1–2); a gap-filler could open 'Ma Yuan' for the campaign's route. Gazetteer: 'Red River Delta' and the admin-1 names resolve.
